# ZERO-TOLERANCE MULTI-AGENT UI/UX & FUNCTIONAL AUDIT REPORT
**Target System:** `42Beirut-Recruit` Studio Workspace  
**Working Branch:** `refine/studio-v2` | **Commit Baseline:** `f9f5629`  
**Audit Viewport Targets:** Desktop Canvas ($1920 \times 1080$), Laptop Standard ($1440 \times 900$), Narrow/Mobile Breakage ($1280 \times 800$)  
**Artifacts Location:** `./audit-screenshots/`  
**Auditing Panel:**
1. **Sub-Agent 1:** Browser Automation & Visual Capture Lead
2. **Sub-Agent 2:** Interactive QA & State Forensics Engineer
3. **Sub-Agent 3:** Principal UI/UX Design Critic (Senior Staff Director)

## 1. Executive Reality Check (No Sugar-Coating)

The `42Beirut-Recruit` application currently suffers from **architectural schizophrenia**: it is torn between an abandoned, high-friction 4-phase wizard (`src/components/wizard/`) and a partially cloned, desktop-biased Rezi Studio layout (`src/components/studio/ReziStudioLayout.tsx`). 

### What Works:
1. **Dr. Wissam Typography & ATS Print Standard:** The underlying A4 resume canvas in [`WissamCleanTemplate.tsx`](file:///C:/Users/Ali_n/Desktop/CV-Builder/src/components/templates/WissamCleanTemplate.tsx) strictly implements Dr. Wissam's single-column Calibri specification, section divider rules, and single-page line budgeting ($1027\text{px}$ printable height).
2. **State Hydration from 42 Intra:** The mock data generation and OAuth token transport in [`mock-data.ts`](file:///C:/Users/Ali_n/Desktop/CV-Builder/src/lib/intra/mock-data.ts) and [`cv-store.ts`](file:///C:/Users/Ali_n/Desktop/CV-Builder/src/lib/store/cv-store.ts) reliably hydrate student names, validated Common Core projects, Piscine dates, and curriculum level.
3. **Institutional ATS Score Engine:** The 5-category audit algorithm and circular meter in [`ScoreEngineModal.tsx`](file:///C:/Users/Ali_n/Desktop/CV-Builder/src/components/studio/ScoreEngineModal.tsx) function reliably against hardcoded heuristic targets.

### What Is Broken:
1. **Responsive Viewport Collapse (The `< 1536px` Blind Spot):** The "Live Side Preview" toggle button and right-hand preview drawer are hardcoded with Tailwind's `hidden 2xl:flex` (`ReziStudioLayout.tsx:1284, 1685`). On standard 13-inch and 14-inch laptops ($1280 \times 800$, $1366 \times 768$, $1440 \times 900$), **the live preview button vanishes from the UI entirely**, locking cadets into a blind form-filling experience.
2. **Horizontal Layout Crushing on Wide Displays:** When the live side preview is enabled on $1920\text{px}$ screens, the sum of fixed column widths ($70\text{px}$ Rail + $308\text{px}$ Aside Deck + $1108\text{px}$ Form Deck + $480\text{px}$ Preview Drawer = $1966\text{px}$) exceeds the viewport width, triggering horizontal scrollbars and squashing form inputs.
3. **Section Reordering Is Completely Missing; Project Reordering Is Defective:**
   - There is **zero capability** for students to reorder resume sections (e.g., placing Projects above Education or Skills). `CVData` has no `sectionOrder` property, and [`WissamCleanTemplate.tsx`](file:///C:/Users/Ali_n/Desktop/CV-Builder/src/components/templates/WissamCleanTemplate.tsx) renders sections in a rigid, hardcoded JSX sequence.
   - For individual projects, the 6-dot drag grip (`GripVertical`) is a **purely cosmetic dead icon** with zero drag handlers.
   - The Chevron move buttons rely on `findIndex` on the global array while operating over a filtered list (`projectCircleFilter`), causing items to jump unpredictably or fail to visually move.
4. **Visual Collisions in the Bullet Editor:** The AI Rewrite split button overlays and collides with diagnostic text badges (`BulletEditorRow.tsx`), rendering verb telemetry and character count tags illegible.
5. **Silent Runtime 500 Errors:** Every initial page load issues two HTTP 500 errors (`/icon.png` and `/favicon.ico`) because an unoptimized $1.7\text{MB}$ `icon.png` overwhelms Next.js metadata image generation.

### What Is Over-Engineered Bloat:
- **Abandoned Wizard Pipeline:** Over 4,000 lines of orphaned wizard code in `src/components/wizard/` (`Step1Login.tsx`, `Step2ProjectSetup.tsx`, `Step3Questionnaire.tsx`, `Step4SplitEditor.tsx`, `BreadcrumbStepper.tsx`) remain in the codebase with outdated cyan/teal colors and redundant forms.
- **Unused Heavyweight Dependencies:** `mammoth` ($1.1\text{MB}$ unpacked for `.docx` parsing) and `unpdf` are loaded despite cadets either syncing directly from 42 Intra or starting from curated institutional defaults.
- **Cognitive Friction in AI Workflows:** Seed question modals and complex multi-mode switches ("builder" vs "preview" vs "cover-letter") increase cognitive load when cadets simply want to tweak bullets and export a 1-page ATS PDF.

## 2. Phase-by-Phase Visual & Functional Breakdown

### Phase 1: Intra Sync & Authentication (Landing Screen)
![Phase 1: Intra Sync & Landing](data:image/png;base64,)

#### What the User Sees & Tries to Do:
The user arrives at the platform to link their 42 Intra profile or click "Quick Start with 42 Cadet Profile" to immediately begin building their resume with pre-populated project achievements.

#### UI/UX Failures:
1. **Severe Design System Divergence:** While the V2 studio is strict 42 Monochrome (`#09090B`, `#0C0C0E`, pure `#FFFFFF`), Phase 1 remains drenched in outdated saturated cyan (`#00BABC`, `from-brand-teal via-cyan-300 to-sky-400`, `bg-brand-teal`). This visual discontinuity makes the landing page look like an entirely different product.
2. **Tilted "Dribbble-Style" Resume Card:** The right column displays an artificially skewed ($2^\circ$ rotated) resume mockup with overlapping floating pill badges. It looks playful and ungrounded rather than executive and institutional.
3. **Misleading Telemetry:** The top stepper displays `Saved just now` and `Mohammad Hamdan` before the user has even clicked an authentication button.

#### Functional Bugs:
1. **Silent Asset Crashes:** Loading Phase 1 produces two HTTP 500 console errors:
   ```
   GET http://localhost:3000/icon.png 500 (Internal Server Error)
   GET http://localhost:3000/favicon.ico 500 (Internal Server Error)
   ```
2. **Missing Direct Skip:** The live Intra OAuth button redirects to `/api/auth/42/login`. If Intra is blocked by campus proxies or Cloudflare challenges, the user has no direct, frictionless way to edit without manual troubleshooting.

---

### Phase 2: Setup & Experience (Form Deck with Live Preview OFF)
![Phase 2: Setup & Experience Preview OFF](data:image/png;base64,)

#### What the User Sees & Tries to Do:
The cadet navigates to the `EXPERIENCE` section. For cadets with zero formal employment, Dr. Wissam's guideline dictates toggling off work experience so that the vertical line budget is reallocated to technical 42 projects.

#### UI/UX Failures:
1. **Massive Void of Dead Screen Space:** At $1920 \times 1080$, more than 45% of the screen is empty black void (`#09090B`). The form deck is artificially restricted to $1108\text{px}$ while the right half of the monitor sits completely unused.
2. **Hidden Toggle on Normal Screens:** The `Live Side Preview: Off` button in the top right of the form deck is styled with `hidden 2xl:flex`. Anyone reviewing this screen on a MacBook or 1080p display scaled to 125% cannot see or toggle the preview.
3. **Low Contrast Micro-copy:** The subtitle `"Industry roles (toggle off to reallocate line budget to 42 projects)"` uses `text-zinc-400` with insufficient optical weight against `#0C0C0E`.

#### Functional Bugs:
1. **Checkbox State Sync Glitch:** The `"Show on CV"` checkbox inside `ReziStudioLayout.tsx:1356` toggles `setShowExperience`, but does not provide immediate feedback on how much vertical line budget was regained unless the user navigates into "Finish Up & Preview".

### Phase 3: Technical Milestones & Bullets (Live Side Preview ON)
![Phase 3: Milestones with Live Side Preview ON](data:image/png;base64,)
![Phase 3: Technical Milestones Projects](data:image/png;base64,)

#### What the User Sees & Tries to Do:
The user selects validated 42 Cursus projects (`Webserv`, `Minishell`, `Cub3D`, `Philosophers`), edits technical bullet points using action verbs, and observes the real-time line budget gauge on the live A4 preview.

#### UI/UX Failures:
1. **Critical Text Collision in Bullet Rows:** As captured in `04-phase3-milestones-live-preview-on.png`, the white `REWRITE BULLET` split-button is laid out on top of the syntax telemetry badges. The text reads as an unreadable mash: `REWRITE BULLEb: Developed Quantified 94 chars`.
2. **Input Truncation:** In the `TECHNOLOGIES STACK` input, the placeholder/value `"C++, HTTP/1.1, Socket Programming, CGI"` is truncated due to a fixed $11\text{px}$ padding and narrow column width.
3. **Illegible Squeezed Document:** Squeezing the live A4 canvas into a $480\text{px}$ drawer renders the 10pt Calibri body text down to roughly 4.5pt on-screen, forcing users to squint or switch modes entirely.

#### Functional Bugs:
1. **Search & Filter Disconnect in Project List:** When clicking filter chips (`CIRCLE 0-2`, `CIRCLE 3-5`), the list filters visually, but the array index used by the move buttons does not map to the filtered index, causing reordering failures (detailed in Section 4).
2. **Live Side Preview Button Label:** When the side drawer is open, the button label reads `Live Side Preview: Drawer` instead of the clean status indicator `Live Side Preview: ON`.

---

### Phase 4: Live Editor & Export (Full Preview Canvas)
![Phase 4: Live Editor & Sides](data:image/png;base64,)

#### What the User Sees & Tries to Do:
The user completes their edits, reviews the final 1-page A4 canvas with Dr. Wissam line-budget telemetry ($787\text{px} / 1027\text{px}$, 77% capacity), and exports either a pixel-perfect PDF via vector print or an ATS-formatted `.docx` file.

#### UI/UX Failures:
1. **Double Navigation Shell:** In "Finish Up & Preview" mode, the sub-nav tabs (`CONTACT`, `EXPERIENCE`, etc.) remain visible even though clicking them does nothing until the user switches back to "Builder Workspace".
2. **Zoom Control Redundancy:** The zoom toolbar offers $75\%$, $90\%$, $100\%$, and $115\%$, but does not persist user preference to `localStorage`, resetting to standard scale on every navigation.

#### Functional Bugs:
1. **Delayed State Sync on Rapid Typing:** Edits made in form textareas update Zustand immediately, but `WissamCleanTemplate` re-measures height via a `ResizeObserver` on every keystroke, causing minor layout thrashing on larger documents.

## 3. Deep-Dive: The "Live Side Preview: ON" & Side Panels Audit

### Visual Proof:
![Preview OFF State](data:image/png;base64,)
![Preview ON (Phase 2)](data:image/png;base64,)
![Preview ON (Phase 3 Projects)](data:image/png;base64,)
![Viewport Breakage at 1280x800](data:image/png;base64,)

### Forensic Critique of Split-Screen Ratios & Math:

#### 1. Geometry Math Breakdown:
- **Left Global Rail:** $70\text{px}$ fixed width.
- **Contextual Aside Deck:** $308\text{px}$ fixed width.
- **Central Form Deck:** `max-w-[1108px]` with variable shrink.
- **Slide-Over Preview Drawer:** $480\text{px}$ fixed width.
- **Combined Width:** $70 + 308 + 1108 + 480 = 1966\text{px}$.

#### 2. The Responsive Collapse Bug (`ReziStudioLayout.tsx:1284, 1685`):
```tsx
// ReziStudioLayout.tsx Line 1284:
<button
  type="button"
  onClick={() => setShowSlideOverPreview(!showSlideOverPreview)}
  className="hidden 2xl:flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 ..."
>
  {showSlideOverPreview ? <span>Live Side Preview: Drawer</span> : <span>Live Side Preview: Off</span>}
</button>

// ReziStudioLayout.tsx Line 1685:
{showSlideOverPreview && (
  <section className="hidden 2xl:flex w-[480px] shrink-0 sticky top-[105px] h-[calc(100vh-130px)]">
    <CanvasPreviewViewport cvData={cvData} ... />
  </section>
)}
```
- Tailwind defines `2xl` as `@media (min-width: 1536px)`.
- On laptops with $1280\text{px}$, $1366\text{px}$, or $1440\text{px}$ screens, `hidden 2xl:flex` evaluates to `display: none`.
- The user is completely denied access to the live side preview unless they possess an external high-resolution monitor.

#### 3. Scrolling Behavior Defects:
- The central form deck and right-hand preview drawer lack synchronized, independent scroll containment. When the form deck content is long (e.g., editing multiple projects), scrolling the window scrolls the page down, while the preview uses `sticky top-[105px] h-[calc(100vh-130px)]`. This creates jarring vertical misalignment when interacting with low-positioned fields.

#### 4. A4 Scaling Math:
- An A4 document at 96 DPI is $794\text{px} \times 1123\text{px}$.
- Cramming $794\text{px}$ into a $480\text{px}$ drawer requires an inline CSS scale factor of $\approx 0.58$.
- At $0.58\times$ scale, 10.5pt Calibri text renders at approximately $6.1\text{px}$ effective size, making real-time verification of wording, typos, and margins painful without constantly switching back and forth.

## 4. Deep-Dive: Section Moving & Reordering Failure Analysis

### Visual Proof:
![Section Reordering Broken State](data:image/png;base64,)

### Code-Level Forensic Diagnosis:

#### Defect A: Total Absence of Resume Section Reordering
In [`src/types/resume.ts`](file:///C:/Users/Ali_n/Desktop/CV-Builder/src/types/resume.ts#L79-L94), the `CVData` interface defines:
```ts
export interface CVData {
  id?: string;
  targetRole: string;
  contact: ContactInfo;
  educationState: EducationState;
  showExperience: boolean;
  education: EducationItem[];
  experience: ExperienceItem[];
  projects: ProjectItem[];
  skills: SkillsData;
  coursework: CourseworkItem[];
  extracurriculars: ExtracurricularItem[];
  styleDensity?: "standard" | "compact";
  showExtracurriculars?: boolean;
}
```
There is **no `sectionOrder: string[]` field**. In [`src/components/templates/WissamCleanTemplate.tsx`](file:///C:/Users/Ali_n/Desktop/CV-Builder/src/components/templates/WissamCleanTemplate.tsx), sections are rendered in a rigid, hardcoded sequence:
1. `contact` (Lines 122–179)
2. `education` (Lines 181–260)
3. `experience` (Lines 262–321)
4. `projects` (Lines 323–387)
5. `skills` (Lines 389–437)
6. `coursework` (Lines 439–485)
7. `extracurriculars` (Lines 487–530)

If a cadet with significant open-source or C system projects wishes to move **Selected Projects above Education** (a common tactic for cadets seeking immediate SWE internships), the application offers no mechanism to do so.

---

#### Defect B: Dead Drag Handle (`GripVertical`)
In [`ReziStudioLayout.tsx:1076`](file:///C:/Users/Ali_n/Desktop/CV-Builder/src/components/studio/ReziStudioLayout.tsx#L1076):
```tsx
<div className="flex items-center gap-2 truncate">
  <GripVertical className="w-4 h-4 text-zinc-600 shrink-0" />
  <div className="truncate">
    <div className="font-bold truncate">{proj.name}</div>
    <div className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 truncate">
      {proj.techStack || "C / C++"} · {proj.bulletPoints.length} bullets
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```
- `<GripVertical />` renders an SVG icon with 6 dots that visually signals draggable affordance to the user.
- **However, the parent `<div>` has neither `draggable={true}`, nor `@dnd-kit`, nor HTML5 `onDragStart` / `onDragOver` / `onDrop` handlers.**
- Clicking and dragging the grip icon initiates browser native text selection, confusing users who expect modern drag-and-drop mechanics.

---

#### Defect C: The Filtered Index Mutation Bug (`ReziStudioLayout.tsx:1064-1110`)
```tsx
// ReziStudioLayout.tsx Lines 1064-1110:
filteredProjects.map((proj) => {
  const isSelected = activeItemId === proj.id;
  const origIdx = cvData.projects.findIndex((p) => p.id === proj.id);
  return (
    <div key={proj.id} ...>
      ...
      {origIdx > 0 && (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={(e) => {
            e.stopPropagation();
            moveProject(origIdx, "up");
          }}
          className="p-1 hover:text-white text-zinc-500 cursor-pointer"
          title="Move Up"
        >
          <ChevronUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
        </button>
      )}
      {origIdx < cvData.projects.length - 1 && (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={(e) => {
            e.stopPropagation();
            moveProject(origIdx, "down");
          }}
          className="p-1 hover:text-white text-zinc-500 cursor-pointer"
          title="Move Down"
        >
          <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
});
```

And in [`cv-store.ts:516-528`](file:///C:/Users/Ali_n/Desktop/CV-Builder/src/lib/store/cv-store.ts#L516-L528):
```ts
moveProject: (index, direction) =>
  set((state) => {
    const projects = [...state.cvData.projects];
    const targetIndex = direction === "up" ? index - 1 : index + 1;
    if (targetIndex < 0 || targetIndex >= projects.length) return state;
    const temp = projects[index];
    projects[index] = projects[targetIndex];
    projects[targetIndex] = temp;
    return {
      lastSavedTimestamp: Date.now(),
      cvData: { ...state.cvData, projects },
    };
  }),
```

**Why this breaks:**
1. Suppose `cvData.projects` contains: `[0: Libft, 1: ft_printf, 2: Webserv, 3: Inception]`.
2. The user clicks filter `CIRCLE 3-5`.
3. `filteredProjects` contains: `[0: Webserv, 1: Inception]`.
4. In the UI, `Webserv` is rendered at visual position 0. However, `origIdx` is `2`.
5. The condition `origIdx > 0` evaluates to `true`, so the **"Move Up" button is rendered on the first visible item**.
6. The user clicks "Move Up" on `Webserv`.
7. `moveProject(2, "up")` swaps `projects[2]` (`Webserv`) with `projects[1]` (`ft_printf`).
8. The store updates, but in the filtered view for `CIRCLE 3-5`, `Webserv` remains at visual position 0 because `ft_printf` is not in Circle 3–5.
9. **To the user, the click appeared completely dead and unresponsive.**

---

### UX Specification for Zero-Latency Section & Item Reordering:

1. **State Store Schema Update:**
   Add `sectionOrder: TemplateSectionId[]` to `CVData` with default:
   `["education", "experience", "projects", "skills", "coursework", "extracurriculars"]`.
2. **Template Dynamic Rendering:**
   In [`WissamCleanTemplate.tsx`](file:///C:/Users/Ali_n/Desktop/CV-Builder/src/components/templates/WissamCleanTemplate.tsx), iterate over `sectionOrder` to dynamically render sections rather than rendering static JSX blocks.
3. **Dedicated Section Reorder Panel:**
   Provide a lightweight, accessible Reorder Deck with:
   - Native HTML5 Drag-and-Drop (or `@dnd-kit/sortable`) with smooth $150\text{ms}$ layout transitions.
   - Fully accessible `Move Up` / `Move Down` keyboard controls (`Space` to grab, `Up`/`Down` arrows to swap, `Enter` to drop).
   - Zero-delay ($0\text{ms}$) Zustand state sync that immediately re-renders the live A4 preview.
4. **Filtered Item Protection:**
   When filtering project or experience items by query or circle, disable drag reordering and display an inline notice: *"Switch to 'ALL' to reorder items"*, preventing index desynchronization.

## 5. Feature Bloat & "Kill List"

The application has accumulated significant dead weight that degrades maintainability, inflates bundle size, and confuses users.

| Feature / File / Package | Location | Impact / Overhead | Verdict | Recommended Action |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Orphaned 4-Phase Wizard** | `src/components/wizard/` (`Step1Login.tsx`, `Step2ProjectSetup.tsx`, `Step3Questionnaire.tsx`, `Step4SplitEditor.tsx`, `BreadcrumbStepper.tsx`) | >4,000 lines of dead, duplicated state logic with conflicting cyan/teal styles. | **KILL** | Delete all 5 wizard files; consolidate auth and profile intake directly into the V2 Studio shell. |
| **`mammoth` Dependency** | `package.json:20` | $1.1\text{MB}$ unpacked. Used only for uploading and parsing old `.docx` resumes. | **KILL** | Remove from `dependencies`. 42 students sync from Intra; parsing unstructured Word docs is brittle and uncalibrated. |
| **`unpdf` Dependency** | `package.json:27` | Heavyweight PDF parsing bundle. | **KILL** | Remove from `dependencies`. Unreliable client-side CV parsing introduces parsing bugs. |
| **Unoptimized $1.7\text{MB}$ `icon.png`** | `src/app/icon.png` | Crashes Next.js metadata image pipeline, throwing 500 errors on every single page load. | **FIX / REPLACE** | Replace with a crisp, optimized $16\times16$ / $32\times32$ SVG/PNG under $5\text{KB}$. |
| **Questionnaire Interstitial Form** | `Step3Questionnaire.tsx` | Forces students to answer 5 text prompts per project before seeing bullets. | **KILL** | Eliminate questions. Pre-populate bullets directly from `knowledge-base.ts` and let cadets edit inline. |
| **Multi-Mode Modals ("Preview" vs "Builder" vs "Drawer")** | `ReziStudioLayout.tsx` | Fragmenting preview into a drawer, a separate view mode, and a modal creates 3 divergent rendering paths. | **UNIFY** | Unify into a clean, responsive 2-column or 3-column layout where the live A4 preview is always active. |

## 6. Prioritized Zero-Mistake Action Plan

### P0: Broken Functionality & Blockers (Immediate Fixes)
1. **Fix Live Side Preview Viewport Lock:**

   - **Fix:** Remove `hidden 2xl:flex`. Replace with responsive flex rules (`flex` on screens $\ge 1024\text{px}$ `lg:flex` with fluid width distribution). On screens $< 1024\text{px}$, provide a clear, floating preview drawer or bottom sheet toggle.

   - **Target:** [`src/components/studio/BulletEditorRow.tsx`](file:///C:/Users/Ali_n/Desktop/CV-Builder/src/components/studio/BulletEditorRow.tsx)
   - **Fix:** Separate the telemetry footer into a dedicated 2-row or flex-wrap structure so that the AI Rewrite split button never overlaps diagnostic badges (`chars`, `words`, `Verb`).

   - **Target:** [`src/app/icon.png`](file:///C:/Users/Ali_n/Desktop/CV-Builder/src/app/icon.png)
   - **Fix:** Replace the $1.7\text{MB}$ image with an optimized $32\times32$ PNG or SVG icon to eliminate runtime 500 errors.
4. **Fix Filtered Project Reorder Glitch:**
   - **Target:** [`ReziStudioLayout.tsx:1086-1111`](file:///C:/Users/Ali_n/Desktop/CV-Builder/src/components/studio/ReziStudioLayout.tsx)
   - **Fix:** When a filter is active (`projectCircleFilter !== "ALL"` or `projectSearchQuery !== ""`), either disable reordering with a tooltip or swap elements according to their visible neighbor in `filteredProjects`.
